items.required: Adopt an actual reviewed target-free exporter/verifier from the native complete calibration record and registry. Its exact source, distinct semantic review, schema, evidence and externally published release authority digest must be pinned. PRELAUNCH permits, FINISHED monitors, self-hashes and certificate acceptance alone do not prove scientific point admission. The native producer contract and distinct review must explicitly cover target-free certificate contents, authentic adopted-V007 provenance, and equality of the complete admitted roster; documenting these obligations does not supply or validate the missing producer.

Resolve native fixed-distance headline u length 3 versus the selected consumer u length 4 with a reviewed compatible consumer/policy successor or an explicitly adopted bridge. Bind the actual native coordinate mode DDO154_DISTANCE_FIXED_AT_REGISTERED and the exact coordinate-addendum/config identity as well as the shared coordinate-file pin: that file alone does not distinguish modes. Preserve original native record/point identity, the original ordered three-u vector and theta_natural custody; a bridge must retain its source identity and explicit reviewed mapping. No padding, relabelling, inferred nuisance value or silent transformation. A compatible four-u mock is not evidence of native compatibility.

The native rectangle membership predicate is independent for fixed inputs, but the current workflow exports scientific points only after the complete decision and two deterministic cache replays. If overlap is wanted, adopt and review an incremental native admission producer with identical scientific/certificate checks and fixed source identities. Do not label partial selected members, region or freeze as final. The authentic native producer must establish the declared campaign/decision scope is complete from its native completion evidence and compare the entire final admitted-point roster, including original log_index/u/theta_natural identities, to the emitted final-decision view. The selected point occurring once, a COMPLETE/FULL_FINAL_DECISION label, matching self-reported hashes or root publication timing alone do not prove full-roster completeness. Require custody to the completed native record, registry verification and both deterministic replay results; do not invent a new native count/schema field or a scientific all-points dependency for the pointwise predicate.

Preserve or explicitly rule Claude4 S4-POST-S1 before-prediction requirement, tied to campaign FINAL_SUMMARY. This build supplies neither the transfer-test cases/thresholds nor its scientific decision.

Bind actual sealed V007 ADOPT_TAIL, exact case block/preregistration/compare/addendum, native COMPLETE and engine_ok, registry verification and recomputed membership, double replay, and guarded plan/admission hashes. The proposed target-free views are not existing native records and require an authentic reviewed producer. Separately identify and byte-pin the authentic externally adopted V007 record required by the selected consumer. v007_adoption_pin must carry that root-selected adopted record, with a verified derivation/binding from the exact seal/prereg/compare/addendum/case and adoption outcome; the verdict VIEW remains separate acceptance evidence. Writer008 currently exports the verdict VIEW, and replacing it with the proposed seal VIEW would not establish authenticity. Root must adopt the actual native representation, followed by a reviewed producer/writer/consumer-compatible successor and negative substitution controls. No current native adoption artifact or new schema is invented here.

Supply actual point-bound NGC EPS/LO proofs and reviewed validity replay for NGC91_K32_MS96, plus all GQ/route preflight conditions belonging to the selected calls. DDO call certificates do not establish NGC readiness. Synthetic outputs deliberately retain pending sentinels; filler success is not scientific acceptance. Explicitly require target-free content for every certificate artifact read by the writer or passed to step5, not only the top-level handoff shape and target_free label. The reviewed native producer must validate the exact real proof schema, allowed fields/types and payload semantics, bind the same checked artifact bytes to the admitted point and scope, and refuse observed/target payloads regardless of key aliases or nesting. If an existing native proof cannot be handed off target-free, root must choose a reviewed target-free representation with retained native proof custody before production; this proposal supplies neither that representation nor new scientific thresholds. Expanding a key-name deny-list or merely publishing a pin does not close SHOULD_FIX2.

The locked policy mechanically accepts r006_fallback or r007, and writer008 still accepts the fallback. This is not evidence that r006 remains the current scientific selection after A93: reconcile the current Claude2 driver adoption/registry/review before issuing an authority. The old producer-contract phrase Choose r006 fallback or provide accepted r007 must not authorize an automatic fallback. Preserve the post-A93 caveat and explicitly select the applicable reviewed driver; a later r008 selection requires a reviewed consumer/policy and writer-binding successor. r007 requires its externally accepted driver-review pin. Route A/B specs remain alternative interfaces to the same integrated A-to-B calculation, not a B-only reuse contract. This document does not select a driver or infer revocation/adoption from a filename.

Claude2 must publish the exact release-authority digest independently of arbitrary input and remains the sole scientific launch owner. Under dispatch0635 the current distinct step4/handoff reviewer is Claude3; its0094 review is received as PASS_WITH_FINDINGS, 0 external BLOCKING and 6 SHOULD_FIX. Codex3 owns the consumer; production producer and exact successor compatibility review remain required. Before publishing a handoff digest, Claude2 must verify the immutable WRITER_RECEIPT bytes, its root-trusted authority/producer bindings, and its export_pin/handoff_pin against the actual emitted bytes, then publish the verified receipt and handoff pins externally. The writer stdout digest alone is not the publication authority. Preserve the receipt for native custody. Existing synthetic tests and the external review do not close authentic-producer or SHOULD_FIX2/3/4 obligations. The in-process verifier restrictions are not a hostile-code sandbox. Every output remains launch_authorized false.

scope_note: Documentation proposal only: no writer/consumer/producer code changed and no SHOULD_FIX2/3/4 closure claimed. Existing source evidence and eight root items retained; actual native production admission and launch readiness remain untested. External seal blocking count is not changed by this semantic report.
